# FILE: Chart.yaml
apiVersion: v2
name: redis-cache
description: A Helm chart for deploying a secure Redis cache with StatefulSet, headless Service, PVC, and Secret-managed password
type: application
version: 0.1.0
appVersion: "7.2"
keywords:
  - redis
  - cache
  - statefulset
  - database
maintainers:
  - name: devops-team
    email: devops@example.com
sources:
  - https://github.com/redis/redis
---
# FILE: values.yaml
nameOverride: ""
fullnameOverride: ""

replicaCount: 1

image:
  repository: redis
  tag: "7.2-alpine"
  pullPolicy: IfNotPresent

imagePullSecrets: []

service:
  port: 6379
  annotations: {}

persistence:
  enabled: true
  accessModes:
    - ReadWriteOnce
  size: 8Gi
  storageClass: ""

resources:
  requests:
    cpu: 50m
    memory: 128Mi
  limits:
    cpu: 500m
    memory: 512Mi

auth:
  existingSecret: ""
  password: ""

podAnnotations: {}

podSecurityContext:
  runAsUser: 1001
  runAsGroup: 1001
  fsGroup: 1001
  fsGroupChangePolicy: "OnRootMismatch"
  seccompProfile:
    type: RuntimeDefault

containerSecurityContext:
  allowPrivilegeEscalation: false
  readOnlyRootFilesystem: true
  capabilities:
    drop:
      - ALL

nodeSelector: {}
tolerations: []
affinity: {}

topologySpreadConstraints: []
priorityClassName: ""

updateStrategy:
  type: RollingUpdate
---
# FILE: templates/secret.yaml
{{- $name := default .Chart.Name .Values.nameOverride -}}
{{- $fullName := default (printf "%s-%s" .Release.Name $name | trunc 63 | trimSuffix "-") .Values.fullnameOverride -}}
{{- $secretName := (default (printf "%s-auth" $fullName) .Values.auth.existingSecret) -}}
{{- if not .Values.auth.existingSecret }}
apiVersion: v1
kind: Secret
metadata:
  name: {{ $secretName }}
  labels:
    app.kubernetes.io/name: {{ $name }}
    app.kubernetes.io/instance: {{ .Release.Name }}
    app.kubernetes.io/version: {{ .Chart.AppVersion | quote }}
    app.kubernetes.io/managed-by: {{ .Release.Service }}
    helm.sh/chart: "{{ .Chart.Name }}-{{ .Chart.Version | replace "+" "_" }}"
type: Opaque
data:
  {{- $existing := (lookup "v1" "Secret" .Release.Namespace $secretName) -}}
  redis-password: {{- if $existing -}}{{ index $existing.data "redis-password" }}{{- else -}}{{ (default (randAlphaNum 32) .Values.auth.password) | b64enc }}{{- end }}
{{- end }}
---
# FILE: templates/service-headless.yaml
{{- $name := default .Chart.Name .Values.nameOverride -}}
{{- $fullName := default (printf "%s-%s" .Release.Name $name | trunc 63 | trimSuffix "-") .Values.fullnameOverride -}}
apiVersion: v1
kind: Service
metadata:
  name: {{ printf "%s-headless" $fullName }}
  labels:
    app.kubernetes.io/name: {{ $name }}
    app.kubernetes.io/instance: {{ .Release.Name }}
    app.kubernetes.io/version: {{ .Chart.AppVersion | quote }}
    app.kubernetes.io/managed-by: {{ .Release.Service }}
    helm.sh/chart: "{{ .Chart.Name }}-{{ .Chart.Version | replace "+" "_" }}"
  annotations:
    {{- toYaml .Values.service.annotations | nindent 4 }}
spec:
  clusterIP: None
  publishNotReadyAddresses: true
  ports:
    - name: redis
      port: {{ .Values.service.port }}
      targetPort: redis
      protocol: TCP
  selector:
    app.kubernetes.io/name: {{ $name }}
    app.kubernetes.io/instance: {{ .Release.Name }}
---
# FILE: templates/statefulset.yaml
{{- $name := default .Chart.Name .Values.nameOverride -}}
{{- $fullName := default (printf "%s-%s" .Release.Name $name | trunc 63 | trimSuffix "-") .Values.fullnameOverride -}}
{{- $secretName := (default (printf "%s-auth" $fullName) .Values.auth.existingSecret) -}}
apiVersion: apps/v1
kind: StatefulSet
metadata:
  name: {{ $fullName }}
  labels:
    app.kubernetes.io/name: {{ $name }}
    app.kubernetes.io/instance: {{ .Release.Name }}
    app.kubernetes.io/version: {{ .Chart.AppVersion | quote }}
    app.kubernetes.io/managed-by: {{ .Release.Service }}
    helm.sh/chart: "{{ .Chart.Name }}-{{ .Chart.Version | replace "+" "_" }}"
spec:
  serviceName: {{ printf "%s-headless" $fullName }}
  replicas: {{ .Values.replicaCount }}
  updateStrategy:
    type: {{ .Values.updateStrategy.type }}
  selector:
    matchLabels:
      app.kubernetes.io/name: {{ $name }}
      app.kubernetes.io/instance: {{ .Release.Name }}
  template:
    metadata:
      labels:
        app.kubernetes.io/name: {{ $name }}
        app.kubernetes.io/instance: {{ .Release.Name }}
      annotations:
        {{- toYaml .Values.podAnnotations | nindent 8 }}
    spec:
      {{- if .Values.priorityClassName }}
      priorityClassName: {{ .Values.priorityClassName | quote }}
      {{- end }}
      {{- if .Values.imagePullSecrets }}
      imagePullSecrets:
        {{- toYaml .Values.imagePullSecrets | nindent 8 }}
      {{- end }}
      securityContext:
        {{- toYaml .Values.podSecurityContext | nindent 8 }}
      containers:
        - name: redis
          image: "{{ .Values.image.repository }}:{{ .Values.image.tag }}"
          imagePullPolicy: {{ .Values.image.pullPolicy }}
          securityContext:
            {{- toYaml .Values.containerSecurityContext | nindent 12 }}
          command: ["/bin/sh","-c"]
          args:
            - |
              exec redis-server \
                --appendonly yes \
                --save "60 1000" \
                --protected-mode yes \
                --requirepass "$REDIS_PASSWORD"
          env:
            - name: REDIS_PASSWORD
              valueFrom:
                secretKeyRef:
                  name: {{ $secretName }}
                  key: redis-password
          ports:
            - name: redis
              containerPort: {{ .Values.service.port }}
              protocol: TCP
          volumeMounts:
            - name: data
              mountPath: /data
            - name: tmp
              mountPath: /tmp
          livenessProbe:
            exec:
              command:
                - sh
                - -c
                - 'redis-cli -a "$REDIS_PASSWORD" PING | grep -q PONG'
            initialDelaySeconds: 20
            periodSeconds: 15
            timeoutSeconds: 5
            failureThreshold: 5
          readinessProbe:
            exec:
              command:
                - sh
                - -c
                - 'redis-cli -a "$REDIS_PASSWORD" PING | grep -q PONG'
            initialDelaySeconds: 10
            periodSeconds: 10
            timeoutSeconds: 5
            failureThreshold: 3
          resources:
            {{- toYaml .Values.resources | nindent 12 }}
      terminationGracePeriodSeconds: 30
      volumes:
        - name: tmp
          emptyDir: {}
      affinity:
        {{- toYaml .Values.affinity | nindent 8 }}
      nodeSelector:
        {{- toYaml .Values.nodeSelector | nindent 8 }}
      tolerations:
        {{- toYaml .Values.tolerations | nindent 8 }}
  {{- if .Values.persistence.enabled }}
  volumeClaimTemplates:
    - metadata:
        name: data
        labels:
          app.kubernetes.io/name: {{ $name }}
          app.kubernetes.io/instance: {{ .Release.Name }}
      spec:
        accessModes:
          {{- toYaml .Values.persistence.accessModes | nindent 10 }}
        {{- if .Values.persistence.storageClass }}
        storageClassName: {{ .Values.persistence.storageClass | quote }}
        {{- end }}
        resources:
          requests:
            storage: {{ .Values.persistence.size }}
  {{- else }}
  volumeClaimTemplates: []
  {{- end }}
